label: noamari
title: の余り
meaning_example: 心配のあまり => because of too much anxiety

notes.text:
can be used for both good and bad things.



心配のあまり 

because of too much anxiety.



嬉しさのあまりとび上がった。 

I was so glad I couldnt help jumping up

examples.body_text:
心配のあまり 

because of 
		too much anxiety.

心配のあまり 
because of too much anxiety.

examples.japanese: 彼女は一番行きたかった大学に合格し、嬉しさのあまり跳び上がった。
examples.body_text:
彼女は一番行きたかった大学に合格し、嬉しさのあまり跳び上がった。 

		Being successful with the eligibility for the University she most wanted to enter, she was 
		so 
glad  she couldn't help jumping up.
examples.body_html:
彼女は一番行きたかった大学に合格し、嬉しさのあまり跳び上がった。 
Being successful with the eligibility for the University she most wanted to enter, she was so glad she couldn't help jumping up.

examples.japanese: 父親の死を知らされて、悲しみのあまり、寝込んでしまいました。
examples.body_text:
父親の死を知らされて、悲しみのあまり、寝込んでしまいました。 

		When people let him know about the death of his father, 
		because of too much 
sadness  , he went laid up completely.
examples.body_html:
父親の死を知らされて、悲しみのあまり、寝込んでしまいました。 
When people let him know about the death of his father, because of too much sadness , he went laid up completely.

shocked that I didn't even cry.
examples.body_html:

I was so shocked that I didn't even cry.

		In Korea, a man who,

hunger  , intended to cook his proprietary dog, have been arrested.
examples.body_html:

In Korea, a man who, because of too much hunger , intended to cook his proprietary dog, have been arrested.

comments.text: あんまり  is often used on its own to mean "That's too much!" / "That's horrible!" "ソレはあんまりよ！"
